data.name: Spermidine
data.description: A natural polyamine present in food and in cells, whose concentration falls with age. It induces autophagy mainly by inhibiting histone acetyltransferases and raising transcription of autophagy genes, which is a route that does not require mTOR inhibition. Studied as a caloric-restriction mimetic (EIS2009, EIS2016).
data.description_beginner: A substance found in food such as wheat germ and aged cheese. It switches on the cell's recycling programme, but by changing which genes are read rather than by blocking mTOR the way rapamycin does.
